limitations: KOI source artwork shows medium and large prices as abbreviated numeric values (e.g. 3.2); transcription preserves the published display and does not infer decimal formatting.
Sushiro artwork uses price tiers such as $2.30++; plus signs are preserved and charges/tax are not inferred.
Full menu artwork includes product images, but no standalone item image URLs were captured. Images are review-only and not cleared for reuse.
Branch availability and price parity are not established by the brand-level sources.
Sushiro source menu page states full menu may be subject to in-store availability.

dedupe.normalization: Unicode NFKD, casefold, alphanumeric-only exact brand item key

sources_already_reviewed: Existing official chain menu snapshots checked; none had KOI Thé or Sushiro menu-item candidate rows. Existing Sushiro delivery menu entries were compared only for exact names, not accepted as source evidence.
